title: Your store's name, logo and colours
summary: How your store's logo and brand colour appear, and how to change them.

blocks.text: Your store's logo and colour show on the sign-in page (once your Store ID is typed), in the menu, on buttons and on your POs. The rest of RetailOps uses KloudC's calm blues and a colour for each area.

items: Your brand colour is adjusted automatically so text on it always stays easy to read, in light and dark.
Your store's name, address and phone print on every PO's letterhead.
To change your logo, colours, name, address or phone, email {support_email} with the new details. A KloudC master updates them.
